units.text: INT. NIGHT FERRY GALLEY - NIGHT
A cramped steel galley, steam rising from a stockpot, a single porthole showing black water and distant harbor lights.
CELESTE ARMITAGE, thirties, a pastry chef in a stained white jacket, leans against the counter, arms folded.
DOMINIC VARGA, thirties, a passenger in a soaked grey coat, stands in the doorway holding a violin case.
CAPTAIN OYELARAN, sixties, silver-bearded, pours coffee into three mugs and hands one to Celeste, one to Dominic, and keeps one.
DECKHAND SUNNY, twenties, wipes down the counter, glancing from Celeste to Dominic and back with obvious amusement.
Ferry Marisol, this is Harbor. Dock three is clear. Over.
units.name: HARBORMASTER

units.text: Harbor, Marisol. Ten minutes out. Over.
units.name: CAPTAIN OYELARAN

units.text: Dominic sets down the violin case.
Celeste picks up a whisk and puts it down.
He crosses the galley, stops a foot from her, and neither of them says anything while the captain sips and Sunny bites his lip.
You said you'd never take this boat again.
units.name: CELESTE

units.text: I said a lot of things in that rain.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: Marisol, confirm passenger count. Over.
units.name: HARBORMASTER

units.text: Harbor, Marisol. Count is... flexible. Over.
units.name: CAPTAIN OYELARAN

units.text: Celeste laughs before she can stop it.
Dominic smiles.
Sunny drops the rag.
I wrote you forty letters.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: I read thirty-nine.
units.name: CELESTE

units.text: Which one did you skip?
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: The one where you said goodbye.
units.name: CELESTE

units.text: The ferry horn blares.
Dominic takes her hand, and she lets him, and the captain turns his back to study the porthole with enormous interest, Sunny scrambling after him with the mugs.
